title: CodingEvent
description: CODE-SPEC-01 (Home docs/design/local-coding-2026-10-17.md section 4.2). One line of a Code session's audit trail: what the agent did. Person scope, owner only, exportable with the session. `secret_found` carries the path and line, never the value. Household logs never carry this record; they hold typed events with no person, text, path or id.

detail.description: The fields for the kind. command: command, exit_code, duration_ms. file_write: path. host_allowed and host_blocked: host. approval: what, answer. push: branch. pull_request: url. secret_found: path, line. checkpoint_restored: checkpoint_id. stopped: reason.
